Class FaissVectorStore

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.AbstractVectorStore
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissVectorStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, tech.kayys.wayang.vector.VectorStore
public class FaissVectorStore extends tech.kayys.wayang.vector.AbstractVectorStore implements AutoCloseable
FAISS implementation of VectorStore using JDK 25 FFM.

Backed by the native FAISS C library via FaissIndex. Supports all index types through the FAISS index factory description string (e.g., "Flat", "HNSW32", "IVF100,Flat", "PQ16", "SQ8").
